history_policy: This version inherits every workload, mode, jobs, warmup, checksum, timing floor, and deferred-family decision from immutable v1. Any later workload, timed-boundary, jobs, checksum, metric, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Adds a separate opt-in tier-attribution sidecar; scored timing contexts remain uninstrumented.

tier_attribution.scope: one fresh zig-js context per workload and structural variant
tier_attribution.invocation: one inherited full-work call with the frozen jobs and lane-zero input
tier_attribution.equivalence: For warmup and invocation independently, each base/variant pair must select the same non-empty set of tree-walker, VM, baseline, optimizer, optimizer-OSR, and deoptimization paths and allocate exactly the same number of environments. Exact counters remain visible rather than normalized away.
tier_attribution.timing_isolation: Attribution uses fresh opt-in contexts outside every scored timing row; normal contexts retain null telemetry and perform no profiling atomics.

recognizer_audit.prohibited: Every representative workload identifier is absent from engine source. Identifiers exist only in the owned workload, manifest, and benchmark tooling.
